work.title: The Egyptian Book of the Dead

data.text: O Bull of Amenta, It is Thoth, the everlasting King, who is here.

work.title: The Egyptian Book of the Dead

data.text: I am the great god in the Bark, who have fought for thee.

work.title: The Egyptian Book of the Dead

data.text: I am one of those gods, the Powers who effect the triumph of Osiris over his adversaries on the day of the Weighing of the Words: I am thy kinsman, Osiris.

work.title: The Egyptian Book of the Dead

data.text: I am one of those gods to whom Nut hath given birth, who slay the adversaries of Osiris and imprison the Sebau, on his behalf: I am thy kinsman, Horus.

work.title: The Egyptian Book of the Dead

data.text: I have fought for thee, and have prevailed for thy name.

work.title: The Egyptian Book of the Dead

data.text: I am Thoth who effect the triumph of Osiris over his adversaries on that day of Weighing of the Words in the House of the Prince, which is in Heliopolis.

work.title: The Egyptian Book of the Dead

data.text: I am Tatti, the son of Tatti, conceived in Tattu and born in Tattu; and Tattu is my name.

work.title: The Egyptian Book of the Dead

data.text: I am with the mourners and weepers who wail over Osiris in Rechit, and who effect the triumph of Osiris over his adversaries.

work.title: The Egyptian Book of the Dead

data.text: Rā issued the mandate to Thoth, that he should effect the triumph of Osiris against his adversaries, and the mandate is what Thoth hath executed.

work.title: The Egyptian Book of the Dead

data.text: I am with Horus on the day of covering Teshtesh and of opening the fountains for the refreshment of the god whose heart is motionless, and closing the entrance to the hidden things in Restau.

work.title: The Egyptian Book of the Dead

data.text: I am with Horus, as the avenger of that left arm of Osiris which is in Sechem.

work.title: The Egyptian Book of the Dead

data.text: I enter in, and I come forth from the Tank of Flame on the day when the adversaries are annihilated at Sechem.

work.title: The Egyptian Book of the Dead

data.text: I am with Horus on the day when the festivals of Osiris are celebrated, and when offerings are made [to Rā], on the Feast of the Sixth day of the Month, and on the Feast of Tenait in Heliopolis.

work.title: The Egyptian Book of the Dead

data.text: I am the Priest in Tattu and exalt him who is on the Height.

work.title: The Egyptian Book of the Dead

data.text: I am the Prophet in Abydos on the day when the earth is raised.

work.title: The Egyptian Book of the Dead

data.text: I am he who seeth what is shut up at Restau.

work.title: The Egyptian Book of the Dead

data.text: I am he who reciteth the liturgies of the Soul who is Lord of Tattu.

work.title: The Egyptian Book of the Dead

data.text: I am the Sem-priest in all that pertaineth to his office.

work.title: The Egyptian Book of the Dead

data.text: I am the Arch-Craftsman, on the day in which the Ship of Sokaru is laid upon its stocks.

work.title: The Egyptian Book of the Dead

data.text: I am he who seizeth the mattock, on the day of the Feast of Hoeing in Suten-henen.

work.title: The Egyptian Book of the Dead

data.text: O ye who bring beneficent souls into the house of Osiris, do ye bring the soul of N together with you into the house of Osiris; let him see as you see, let him hear as you hear, let him stand as you stand, and sit as you sit [in the house of Osiris].

work.title: The Egyptian Book of the Dead

data.text: O ye who give bread and beer to beneficent souls in the house of Osiris, do you give bread and beer at the two periods to the soul of N who is with you.

work.title: The Egyptian Book of the Dead

data.text: O ye who unclose the ways and open the roads to beneficent souls in the house of Osiris, unclose then the ways and open the roads to the soul of N who is with you, let him enter boldly and come forth in peace at the house of Osiris, without hindrance and without repulse. Let him enter at his pleasure and go forth at his will, triumphantly with you; and let that be executed which he shall order in the house of Osiris.

work.title: The Egyptian Book of the Dead

data.text: No lightness of his in the scale has been found and the Balance is relieved of his case.
